"This chart, titled **"Monetary Financing and Debt Service,"** displays cumulative financial data in billions of Argentine Pesos (AR$) starting from January 2022 through early 2024.

### Chart Components
*   **Title:** Monetary Financing and Debt Service
*   **Subtitle:** (Billions of AR$, cumulative since 2022)
*   **X-axis:** Monthly timeline from Jan-22 to Jan-24.
*   **Primary Y-axis (Left):** Values for Monetary Financing (0 to 3000 Billions AR$).
*   **Secondary Y-axis (Right - rhs):** Values for Domestic debt service (0 to 30,000 Billions AR$).
*   **Legend:**
    *   **Dark Blue Bars:** Domestic debt service (measured against the right-hand axis).
    *   **Light Blue Line:** Monetary Financing (measured against the left-hand axis).

### Data Values (Estimated from Chart)

The values below are estimates based on the axes provided in the chart image.

| Month | Domestic Debt Service (Bars, rhs) [Billions AR$] | Monetary Financing (Line, lhs) [Billions AR$] |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Jan-22 | ~200 | ~125 |
| Feb-22 | ~600 | ~125 |
| Mar-22 | ~1,000 | ~125 |
| Apr-22 | ~2,100 | ~200 |
| May-22 | ~3,100 | ~50 |
| Jun-22 | ~3,300 | ~450 |

| Dec-22 | ~5,600 | ~620 |
| Jan-23 | ~6,100 | ~620 |
| Feb-23 | ~6,600 | ~620 |

| Jan-24 | ~20,600 | ~2,300 |
| Feb-24* | ~26,100 | ~2,300 |

*\*Note: The final data point shown in the chart occurs after Jan-24.*

### Summary of Trends
*   **Domestic Debt Service:** Shows a consistent, accelerating upward trend, starting near zero in Jan-22 and rising to approximately 26,000 billion AR$ by early 2024.
*   **Monetary Financing:** Remained relatively flat through much of 2022 and early 2023 (around 620 billion AR$), saw a sharp spike between March 2023 and July 2023 (peaking at ~2,600 billion AR$), and has remained flat at approximately 2,300 billion AR$ since August 2023."
